method.aggregation: same production crem event machines in both paths

notes: Complete local rounds: ReqTx, ReqSn, three AckSn, signing, verification and aggregation. Fixture and equality checks are outside timing.
Four grid runs, two in each order. Large Cardano case repeated for ten seconds in both orders after one grid estimate exceeded 5%.
Builds and tests stopped during measurement. Times drift across runs despite fixed CPU affinity; ranges are observations, not confidence bounds.
No transport, API, disk or full-node TPS. The checksum forces a state projection, not every field. No ReqDec or Recover timing.
Reports retain Criterion estimates, regressions, outlier variance and sample counts; density estimates and raw samples are omitted.
